title: VISUAL CUES OF GENDER AND RACE ARE ASSOCIATED WITH STEREOTYPING IN VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating open-ended stories from facial images of men and women with varying gender prototypicality, calculating pairwise cosine similarity of sentence embeddings to measure homogeneity bias, and using Structural Topic Models (STMs) to assess gender-based trait associations.

Generating open-ended stories from facial images of Black and White Americans with varying racial prototypicality, calculating pairwise cosine similarity of sentence embeddings to measure homogeneity bias, and using Structural Topic Models (STMs) to identify race-based trait associations.
